input.quote: 4.1 License Fees. In consideration for the licenses granted to Corio pursuant to Section 2 of this Agreement, Corio shall pay the license fees specified in EXHIBIT B hereto. Payment terms of such license fees shall be as set forth in EXHIBIT B hereto.
input.rationale: We are the customer/licensee (Corio) paying Commerce One as licensor/host. The fee provisions (Section 4, Exhibit B pricing, revenue sharing and Exhibit B payment terms) impose only ordinary licence, maintenance, MarketSite access, implementation and revenue-share fees on Corio; there are no liquidated damages, penalty amounts, late-payment interest or minimum/early-termination fees payable by Corio. Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalt", "interest" and "minimum" return no customer-payable stipulated-damages provisions. Section 11 termination contains no termination fee or accelerated/minimum payment; the only post-termination payments (11.3) are for continued use of the Software by existing customers, i.e. value actually received. Section 9's liability cap is mutual and does not stipulate damages. This satisfies the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), so no redline is required.
